plugins.description: Rust language-level idioms, design & compiler-error diagnosis (Rust 1.100 / edition 2024): ownership/lifetimes, error handling, traits/generics/dyn, iterators/closures, async-tokio Send, macros, testing, unsafe/FFI, modules/crates, E0xxx table. Every snippet cargo-check verified. Complements salvo-skill (framework) & rust-analyzer-lsp (tooling).
